answer_1.quote: This work studies the feasibility of generating morally framed arguments computationally and the effect of these arguments on different audiences.
answer_1.outputs: Arguments with specific moral framing (care, fairness, loyalty, authority, purity)

answer_4.quote: To evaluate our hypothesis on the effect of morally framed arguments, we carried out a user study with two opposing target audiences, liberals and conservatives.
answer_4.guideline: For each pair, the participants read the three arguments and ranked them by perceived effectiveness, defined as how empowering it is (if the participant has the same stance) or how challenging it is (otherwise).
